_comment: Tuning for the runtime mission types (scripts/mission_types.gd, issue #113). window: how Raid and Salvage chances come and go on the Command Table: every 'period' days a province offers one for 'open' days (each province on its own phase), then waits 'cooldown' days after you go, win or lose. threat_names: the briefing's word for threat 1-5. raid: grab caches from a faction's land before its garrison closes in. Offered on a faction-held province that borders your land, unless that faction is Friendly or better. factions.<id>: guards (spawn weights of data/enemies.json kinds standing watch over each cache and coming as reinforcements), per_cache (guards at each cache), cache (what one cache holds: [min, max]; resources or Forge materials from data/materials.json), quiet / loud (standing change when you get away unseen / once the alarm went up), rival (factions glad to see it: standing change on success). caches: how many sit on the map, need: how many you must carry out, seconds: time before the garrison arrives, alarm_cap: seconds left once the alarm is raised, open_time: seconds to pry one open. salvage: pull what the Blank has not finished eating out of its edge. Offered on your land or unclaimed land with Fray at or above min_fray, or next to erased land. pile: what one pile holds; near_bonus: up to this much more for a pile right at the white's edge; creep: px/s the white advances (plus creep_per_fray x Fray/10) once it starts; it holds still for as long as the walk to the nearest pile takes plus grace seconds; push: px a kill pushes it back. Rewards on top of what the caches hold are paid on success. region_cache / region_pile (issue #138): extra contents per cache or pile in a province of that region (data/provinces.json), so raids and salvage in a chapter's region turn up its Forge materials; a raid only adds them when the faction's own cache holds none of that region's materials.

concord.name: Concord tithe-store
concord.brief: The Concord keeps its seized tithes in strongboxes along the road, watched by clerks with very large friends. Prise open at least %d of the %s and get out before the garrison rides in. Stay out of sight and they may never know it was you.

guild.name: Guild cargo
guild.brief: Guild barges unload toll cargo on the landing, and the Guild charges both ways for the privilege. Take at least %d of the %s back before their sellswords finish their dice game. Quietly, if you can.

coven.name: Coven stores
coven.brief: The Coven leaves its stores in the woods under guard of things it raised from old letters. Lift at least %d of the %s before the witches notice the woods have gone quiet.

abbey.name: Abbey undercroft
abbey.brief: The Abbey keeps its plate and its spare bell-metal in the undercroft, and the brothers the Blank got to still keep watch over it. Bring up at least %d of the %s before the house wakes.

erasers.name: Eraser book-pyres
erasers.brief: The Erasers stack what they have looted from the Abbey's outhouses on pyres, to burn at their next reading. Pull at least %d of the %s out before the Readers come back with their tapers.

velvet.name: Velvet wine cellars
velvet.brief: Under the Causeway the Nobility keep their cellars: wine for the masquerade, rope for the curtains, and pearls nobody admits to owning. Carry up at least %d of the %s before the duellists notice the music has changed key.

salvage.brief: The white is eating %s from the east, and what it has not finished is still lying at its edge: carts, cellars, a chapel's plate. Pull at least %d of the %s out before it swallows them. The closer to the white, the better the pickings.
